db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Bulk insert payments
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import toInsertParameters from dw::modules::Payments --- payload map toInsertParameters($)]
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO payment (run_id, file_name, line_number, payment_reference, payee_name, payee_abn, bsb, account_number, amount, payment_date, description) VALUES (:runId, :fileName, :lineNumber, :paymentReference, :payeeName, :payeeAbn, :bsb, :accountNumber, :amount, CAST(:paymentDate AS DATE), :description)

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Bulk insert rejects
db:bulk-insert.db:bulk-input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import toRejectParameters from dw::modules::Payments --- payload map toRejectParameters($)]
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO payment_reject (run_id, file_name, line_number, payment_reference, payee_name, payee_abn, bsb, account_number, amount, payment_date, reasons) VALUES (:runId, :fileName, :lineNumber, :paymentReference, :payeeName, :payeeAbn, :bsb, :accountNumber, :amount, :paymentDate, :reasons)

db:select.doc:name: Loaded totals
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loaded_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS loaded_amount FROM payment WHERE run_id = :runId

db:select.doc:name: Rejected rows
db:select.db:sql: SELECT line_number, payment_reference, payee_name, payee_abn, bsb, account_number, amount, payment_date, reasons FROM payment_reject WHERE run_id = :runId ORDER BY line_number
